title: Raise plan
intro: A working plan for whether to raise a first round, how much, from whom and on what kind of instrument, and what you'll do if it doesn't happen. Share it with your co-founders, mentors and the lawyer who reviews any documents; it isn't legal or investment advice.

fields.label: Company or project name
fields.help: Use your working name if you haven't registered a company yet, for example the name on your landing page.

fields.label: Why raise now (or why not)
fields.help: Say what the money would let you do that customers' money, revenue or grants can't, for example 'We need an engineer to finish a two-hospital pilot before their budgets are set.'

fields.label: How much, and the months of runway it buys
fields.help: Multiply your monthly spending by the months to your milestone plus a buffer, for example 18 months at $15,000 a month is $270,000.
fields.placeholder: e.g. $270,000, about 18 months at $15,000 a month

fields.label: The milestone it gets you to
fields.help: One specific, checkable result that makes the company stronger, for example '50 paying clinics, most still paying after their first three months'.

fields.label: The instrument you expect to use
fields.help: For example a SAFE (a US practice), a convertible note, a local equivalent or a priced round, to be reviewed by a lawyer where your company is registered.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Post-money SAFE, to be reviewed by our lawyer

fields.label: Target investor types and your investor list
fields.help: One investor per line, starting with the type, for example 'Angel: former clinic owner who invests in health software, intro via a mentor'.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Pre-seed fund: backs pet and vet businesses in our region

fields.label: Your three-sentence pitch
fields.help: Sentence one says what you do and for whom, sentence two gives your best evidence, and sentence three says what this money will achieve.
fields.placeholder: e.g. We send automatic appointment reminders for small vet clinics. Twelve clinics pay us, and their missed visits fell by a third. This round gets us to 50 paying clinics in 12 months.

fields.label: Materials ready
fields.help: List what's ready and mark anything still in progress, for example 'One-page summary (ready)' or 'Cap table (in progress)'.

fields.label: Timeline
fields.help: Give dates for preparing, meeting investors and deciding, for example 'Materials ready by 1 March, meetings through April, decision by 30 April'.

fields.label: What you'll do if you can't raise
fields.help: Describe the plan you'll switch to on your decision date, for example 'Cut spending to $6,000 a month, sell annual plans upfront and apply for two grants'.
